captions.detailed: This 3D model features a Newtonian reflector telescope mounted on a detailed German equatorial mount and a sturdy tripod. The main optical tube is light gray with black trim rings, a smaller finder scope, and an eyepiece near the upper rim. It is supported by a black equatorial head with a visible counterweight shaft and dual cylindrical counterweights. The assembly rests on a silver-colored tripod with three legs, a central column, and a black spreader plate.
captions.instruction: Generate a Newtonian reflector telescope on a German equatorial mount with a tripod. The telescope should feature a light gray main optical tube with black tube rings, a finder scope, and an eyepiece. The mount must include a polar axis, a declination axis, a counterweight shaft with counterweights, and be supported by a three-legged tripod with a central spreader.
captions.factory: Construct the telescope using hierarchical parts and rotational joints. Build the tripod base with a central cylinder, three angled cylinder legs, and a spreader plate. Mount the equatorial head on top using a revolute polar axis joint. Construct the declination housing with a perpendicular revolute joint, extending to a counterweight shaft with two cylindrical weights on one end and tube rings on the other. Model the main optical tube as a large cylinder with hollow ends, adding smaller cylinders for the finder scope and eyepiece, and attach it to the tube rings.
